properties.selection_rationale: Uncontaminated replacement for the original Atacama window, which contains a large industrial complex. Moved 8 km due south under a selection rule fixed before any terrain value was computed (see app/scripts/register_atacama_south.py). Arid Andean-foreland terrain with alluvial surfaces and low ridges.
known_limitations: The measured window does not represent the complete Atacama Desert
Unpaved tracks and a survey grid cross the window (narrower than one 60 m cell)
Atacama life-detection research elsewhere in the desert does not validate this exact window
Aridity, salts and soil chemistry are not measured by the terrain features
properties.creation_method: Geodetic display footprint approximated from a 10 km square; processing constructs an exact UTM metric grid around the centre.
properties.planetary_target: The registered 10 km Jezero reference window under terrain-only comparison.
properties.representativeness: Feature-focused window; it does not represent the whole region.
properties.known_selection_bias: Phase 9 replacement chosen by a contamination rule before its terrain was measured; independent AOI review pending.
